user_request_summary: 慎重确定开发框架与技术栈，考虑实现难度和成熟度。

decision.orchestration: LangGraph Graph API, first-release 1.x API line
decision.model_integration: langchain-core plus provider-specific langchain-openai / langchain-anthropic adapters, wrapped by ModelClient
decision.persistence: langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite and local artifacts; JSONL event exports
decision.environment: uv with real uv.lock to be resolved and tested during isolated integration
decision.remote: HTTPX -> FastAPI/Uvicorn with separate execution process and local job registry
decision.application: Project-matched DevEco/SDK, Hvigor, ohpm, hdc, Hypium in separate tool environments

why: Stateful repair branches and long-running remote jobs make mature checkpointing useful; keep custom code focused on domain policy, tool version binding and verification.
changes: Updated current design, blueprint, contracts, plan and status coherently.
Set .python-version and project Python requirement to the selected 3.13 baseline.
Registered inspected primary engineering sources without claiming integration or exact dependency lock.
limitations: Exact dependency compatibility and SDK versions require subsequent isolated integration checks.
Checkpointing does not guarantee exactly-once remote actions or model billing.
No actual model provider, remote endpoint or device configured.
